name: W.A.G payment solutions plc
research_rationale: Research stays neutral on hold: quality screens still lean on FY filing cash, but H1 TTM FCF weakness and FCF basis gaps are unresolved; TA exit and rebranding do not fix leverage or liquidity.

weekly_updates.summary:
No material change since the 25 Sep structured verdict.
News since then is mostly Yahoo options pages and third-party price commentary, not company disclosures or trading updates.
H1 2026 cash-flow weakness and filing vs screen FCF divergence are unchanged; no new filings in this batch.

Since 18 Oct, RNS records a TA affiliate secondary placing (~12.7% of issued capital at £1.00, Oct) and registration of the rename to Eurowag Group plc (effective 4 Nov).
The 7 Nov news batch has no new trading updates or accounts—mostly options pages and third-party valuation commentary.
H1 2026 cash weakness and filing versus screen FCF divergence are unchanged; the screen remains on hold.
